newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Turnbull steps down from NAB, Burns Philp.
newsitem.headline: Turnbull steps down from NAB, Burns Philp.

text.p: Three leading Australian companies said on Thursday that Andrew Turnbull had resigned as a director for personal reasons.
The companies were National Australia Bank Ltd, transport group Brambles Industries Ltd and Burns Philp and Co Ltd.
They did not elaborate on the reasons for his resignation.
Turnbull was also chairman of Burns Philp. The Sydney-based food ingredients company said it had appointed Alan McGregor as interim chairman while a permament replacement was found.
Turnbull was elected chairman of Burns Philp in September 1994 following his retirement as managing director.
NAB said its number of directors would be reduced to 11 with Turnbull's resignation.
